system.description:
Grit; 6 Sharp; Medium (50 ft). Reload: needs an Interact Action to reload after each Strike. Pinned: a Large or smaller enemy it hits can't Move until it spends its Interact Action pulling the harpoon out, taking 1 wound.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.141
system.summary: Grit; 6 Sharp; Medium (50 ft). Reload: needs an Interact Action to reload after each Strike. Pinned: a Large or smaller enemy it hits can't Move until it spends its Interact Action pulling the harpoon out, taking 1 wound.

automation.note: Pinned: the target is Immobile until it spends its Interact Action removing the projectile, which gives it 1 wound. Only Large or smaller enemies are pinned, so remove Immobile from anything bigger.
